map.可复现算例：60kg 起、8 周递增规划: Reproducible example: an 8-week progression starting at 60 kg
map.输入：起始重量 60kg、4 组×8 次、周期 8 周、周递增率 2.5%。\n:
Input: starting weight 60 kg, 4 sets × 8 reps, period 8 weeks, weekly increase rate 2.5%.
Week by week (cur is the end-of-week weight for non-deload weeks, deloading back 10% every 4 weeks):
Week 1 60×1.025=61.5, week 2 63.0, week 3 64.6, week 4 deload=64.6×0.9=58.2, week 5 66.2, week 6 67.9, week 7 69.6, week 8 deload=69.6×0.9=62.6 kg.
Ending weight endW≈69.6 kg, +9.6 kg from the start (+16.0%); weekly volume 61.5×4×8=1968 in the first week and 69.6×4×8≈2227 kg in the last training week.
Conclusion: the 8-week linear plan pushes the main lift from 60 kg to about 69.6 kg, with weeks 4 and 8 as deload weeks for recovery.
map.新手/中级者每周 2–5% 线性递增常见且安全；老手因接近极限，常改用周期化（如: For beginners/intermediate lifters a 2-5% weekly linear increase is common and safe; advanced lifters, being close to their limits, often switch to periodisation (e.g. 3 weeks up, 1 week deload) or undulating loads. This tool uses a fixed 2.5% as a clear demonstration, and in practice you can lower it at a plateau.
map.减载周会不会把进度抵消？: Will a deload week cancel out progress?
map.不会。减载周只临时回落 10% 左右并降低容量，目的是缓解中枢神经与关节疲劳，之: No. A deload week only dips about 10% temporarily and reduces volume, to relieve central-nervous-system and joint fatigue; afterwards recovery brings back a higher starting point (e.g. week 5 above is already higher than week 3), which over the long run favours continued progress.
